name: Mikrozensus Wohnen: housing costs

measures.definition: Average monthly rent per m² of every main tenancy in the province, service charges included, times 50 m².
Average monthly rent per m² of every main tenancy in the province, service charges included, times 90 m².

rights.edition: Ergebnisse im Überblick: Wohnkosten (Mikrozensus), table 2, created 8 September 2026
rights.attribution: Source: STATISTIK AUSTRIA, Mikrozensus Wohnen (edited: rate per m² times a flat size)

vetted.notes: Official; the publisher's terms allow commercial and non-commercial reproduction citing STATISTIK AUSTRIA, with edits marked.

caveats: Every main tenancy, a little over half of them municipal or cooperative flats a newcomer rarely gets at once; private flats let in the last two years cost about a third more per m² nationally.
